Thanks Aisha — great context. I attached a short model but below are the headline unit-econ slices so you have them ahead of the call. I’ll walk through on Tue.

Assumptions (pilot -> production):
- Pilot tokens/month: 250k (month 1) -> 1.0M (month 3)
- Avg tokens per feature: 150 (median), 300 for heavy flows

Redwood indicative inference pricing (net of standard discounts; final pricing depends on reserved capacity / commitment):
- Conservative (shared, no quant): ~$220 / 1M tokens
- Optimized (dedicated + 8-bit quant + batching): ~$85 / 1M tokens
- Enterprise reserved (high commitment + further ops tuning): ~$55 / 1M tokens

Unit economics derived (using 150 tokens / feature):
- Features per 1M tokens = 1,000,000 / 150 ≈ 6,666 features
- Cost per feature (@$220/1M) ≈ $0.033 
- Cost per feature (@$85/1M) ≈ $0.013 
- Cost per feature (@$55/1M) ≈ $0.0083

What this means vs your targets: 
- To hit $100–$150 / 1M tokens target, we can do that with a dedicated/optimized setup (~$85) after a pilot that confirms token distribution and batching effectiveness.
- If your revenue per feature is $0.10, then at $85/1M (cost per feature ~$0.013) contribution margin on inference alone is ~87% (noting other infra costs still apply). That creates a comfortable buffer for CAC payback at 6 months.

Recommended pilot structure and asks:
1) 3-month pilot with reserved burst capacity: start at 250k tokens/mo and ramp to 1M.
2) Redwood provides: a performance- and cost-reporting dashboard (token breakdown, avg latency, batch saturation) and a short eval of quantization impact on quality for your top 5 prompt templates.
3) Budget ask: pilot run-rate target $10k–$12k/mo (aligned to your internal band); production target pricing scenario modeled at $85/1M with a 6–12 month commitment to reach $55/1M.

Next actions for Tue 8/11 call:
- Walk through the workbook numbers (I’ll share screen)
- Confirm pilot SLAs and measurement plan
- Align on expected acceptance criteria for production (quality delta tolerance, latency SLOs)

Looping in Rishi (cc) so he’s aware of the proposed pricing tiers and pilot structure.

Thanks — Marissa
